data.one_liner: Manages and manipulates cookies inside WebViews for Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides methods to get, set, remove, and clear web cookies using native CookieManager on Android and httpCookieStore on iOS. It helps handle cookies efficiently alongside webview_flutter or directly.
use_when: You need to read or write web cookies for a WebView in Flutter
You need to manage authentication state or session cookies across web views
avoid_when: You are looking for general local key-value storage (use SharedPreferences instead)
You need full browser automation rather than just cookie management
strengths: Supports both Android and iOS native cookie stores
Works well standalone or combined with webview_flutter
Supports modern integration like Swift Package Manager alongside CocoaPods
weaknesses: Requires minimum iOS deployment target configuration
data.setup_notes: Requires minimum iOS deployment target of 11.0. For Swift Package Manager, use Flutter 3.44 or newer; otherwise, CocoaPods remains supported.

alternatives.name: webview_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides the official WebView widget, though advanced standalone cookie management often pairs with or utilizes packages like webview_cookie_manager_plus.

data.minimal_example:
final cookieManager = WebviewCookieManager();
final gotCookies = await cookieManager.getCookies('https://youtube.com');
